Pets of the Week – Furby and Doodoo

by Administrator
August 2, 2026
1 min read
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:53
Instaread

FARMINGTON — Pets of the Week is a regular column highlighting pets available for adoption at the Franklin County Animal Shelter.

Furby (m) 10+ years old – this senior Shih Tzu mix is ready to retire – in your lap! He loves nice, leisurely walks for sniffing, peanut butter bones to snack on, and snuggling!

DooDoo (f) – is a sleek black lady with an air of royalty. She loves to observe her minions from high up on the shelves in cat room and would love to nap in your window!

 

 

FCAS is accepting registrations for our Strut for Strays 5K fundraiser at Titcomb Mountain, on September 12. Visit our website to register today! www.fcanimalshelter.org

You can find info and updates on the Franklin County Animal Shelter Facebook Page – https://www.facebook.com/fcanimalshelter

You can also make a donation via this link.

For more information visit https://fcanimalshelter.org/
